headline: Indonesian Police Chief Details Illegal Surveillance Investigation
seoTitle: Indonesian Police Chief Discusses Illegal Surveillance Probe
metaDescription: Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto addressed the Indonesian Parliament regarding a criminal investigation into illegal surveillance of national figures.
aiSummaryBullets: Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto outlined the chronology and methodology of alleged illegal surveillance targeting the President and other officials.
The investigation reportedly implicates former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo as the individual who issued the initial verbal orders.
Authorities have identified four suspects in the case, including an operator, with one individual currently placed under house arrest.
aiContextParagraph: During a working meeting with Commission III of the Indonesian House of Representatives (DPR) on November 12, 2026, National Police Chief General Suyudi Ario Seto provided a comprehensive briefing on an ongoing investigation into illegal surveillance activities. The inquiry centers on allegations that unauthorized monitoring was conducted against several prominent targets, including President Prabowo Subianto, members of the legislature, activists, and officials from legal institutions. According to testimony provided by the current Police Chief, the operation originated from verbal directives issued by former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo. These instructions were reportedly passed down through a chain of command to other personnel for execution. Investigators have established a five-stage operational framework for the surveillance, and four suspects have been identified and processed in relation to the case, with one suspect currently subject to house arrest as the judicial process continues.
whyItIsViral: The story has achieved a high viral activity score due to rapid coverage across multiple major media outlets and significant public interest in the parliamentary hearing.
